harbor_path.name: Harbor Path
harbor_path.base_description: A narrow gravel path hugs the cliff above the harbor. Gulls wheel over the breakers below, and the lighthouse on the headland stands dark for the first time in living memory.

village_square.name: Saltmere Village Square
village_square.base_description: A small flagstone square with a weather-beaten notice board and a covered well. Cottages lean inward as if conferring. Paths run east to the chapel, west toward the docks, and a side lane leads to the keeper's cottage.

keepers_cottage.name: Keeper's Cottage
keepers_cottage.base_description: The cottage smells of beeswax and old paper. A stopped clock ticks in memory above the hearth. Irene's mourning shawl is folded neatly on the chair her husband used to occupy.

cliffside_chapel.name: Cliffside Chapel
cliffside_chapel.base_description: A small whitewashed chapel perched on the cliff. Wax has run down the votive table in long pale rivulets. The wind here carries voices that may or may not be your own.

dock_pier.name: Tide-Gate Pier
dock_pier.base_description: Beyond a salt-rusted iron gate, the pier juts out over green water. Crates wait under a tarpaulin, and the lighthouse rises directly above, silent.

harbor_notice.name: Harbor Notice
harbor_notice.description: A printed notice nailed to the village board.

properties.text: By order of the Constable: the tide-gate pier is closed pending inquiry into the death of Keeper Aldric Thorne. No vessel to load or unload without writ.

weathered_lantern.name: Weathered Lantern
weathered_lantern.description: An old oil lantern with a cracked pane, the kind harbor watch carry on rough nights.

keepers_journal.name: Keeper's Journal
keepers_journal.description: A leather-bound journal in a tight, careful hand. The last entry breaks off mid-sentence.

properties.text: Storm tonight. Light held. Saw a shape on the pier - not a fisher. Will not write the name down. If anything happens, ask

chapel_candle.name: Chapel Candle
chapel_candle.description: A half-burned beeswax candle. A folded scrap of paper has been pressed into the soft wax.

properties.text: Forgive me, Aldric. I did not know the chest held what it held.

tide_gate_key.name: Tide-Gate Key
tide_gate_key.description: A long iron key on a salt-pitted ring. The bow is shaped like a stylized wave.

pressed_violet.name: Pressed Violet
pressed_violet.description: A single dried violet pressed flat between two pieces of waxed parchment. It still holds a faint scent.

cipher_locket.name: Cipher Locket
cipher_locket.description: A brass locket with no portrait inside - only a strip of paper marked with rows of numbers.

properties.text: 3-7-2 / 4-1-9 / tide turns at the third hour

salt_stained_chest.name: Salt-Stained Chest
salt_stained_chest.description: A small sea chest, its lid still sealed with cooled wax. The grain of the wood is dark with brine.

constable_writ.name: Constable's Writ
constable_writ.description: A folded warrant bearing Tomas's seal, authorizing the bearer to inspect the tide-gate pier.

properties.text: Let the bearer pass the tide-gate without hindrance. Signed, Deputy Constable Tomas Vell.
